title: Foo Bar Taxi End-to-End Ingestion to API
description: Build an end-to-end analytics pipeline: fetch January 2024 NYC taxi data from the TLC public dataset, load into ClickHouse with a well-designed schema, create materialized views for pre-aggregation, and expose HTTP API endpoints for trip stats and fare analysis.
lede: In this scenario, an agent starts from a greenfield ClickHouse instance and must build a complete pipeline: fetching parquet data from the NYC TLC, designing an analytics schema, creating materialized views for common queries, and exposing API endpoints for trip statistics and fare analysis.

tasks.description: Download January 2024 yellow and green taxi trip parquet files from the NYC TLC dataset and load them into ClickHouse with a unified schema.
Design a proper analytics table with appropriate column types, a taxi_type discriminator, and ORDER BY suitable for analytics queries.
Create materialized views for trip stats, fare analysis, and common aggregations to achieve sub-200ms query performance.
Build HTTP API endpoints for trip statistics, fare analysis, and optionally taxi_type filtering.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse running but empty. Agent must fetch parquet data from the NYC TLC public dataset, load it, build MVs, and expose API endpoints.
